review_question: Does Core want to admit this independently named native-DBC duration scope as a third-family candidate, comparing q=.75/dp=.0075 against the existing q=.5/q=1.0 dynamic closed-catchment DBC baselines while treating static v3 only as the input source?
why_executable: The q=.75 Definition.xml, motion.dat, GenCase output and native BI4 were generated successfully on CPU.
The prepared manifest proves finite unique native arrays, zero initial fluid velocity, source-lattice equality, mass gate and target-angle hold through 5 s.

The prepared manifest records physical_geometry_changed=false relative to the dynamic DBC baselines and physical_geometry_changed=true relative to static v3 because the catchment side walls are a new physical region.
The existing core_f2_qualification dynamic runner and audit owner can consume the prepared manifest after a root-approved job.
The new q=.75 input is a new case identity and does not retry the completed q=.5 or q=1.0 canary input.
known_risks: The q=.5 and q=1.0 DBC canaries both reached 5 s with hard integrity but were right-censored by the settled speed gate; q=.75 may fail the same event gate.
The mDBC moving-contact failures remain evidence that boundary formulation and continuous contact are separate risks; this candidate fixes DBC Boundary=1 and does not claim mDBC behavior.
The finite catchment observes spill and recontact but does not turn event completion into T1 until all 15 independent rows pass.

static v3 is treated as source provenance; geometry change relative to it is explicit
q=.5/q=1.0 native-DBC closed-catchment inputs are the dynamic comparison baselines
q=.75 changes rotation duration only relative to those dynamic baselines
static hold is excluded from the dynamic family claim

requested_decision_sequence.action: issue a separate root approval for the first scientific matrix row q=.75, dp=.0075
only after row-level audit, decide whether to execute the remaining 14 independent rows

failure_handling.event_censor: retain row in denominator, mark event_window_complete=false, no horizon extension or threshold relaxation
failure_handling.infrastructure_failure: retain receipt and row status; classify separately from scientific failure and do not count as pass
